response.overview: La Nane, Wati, and Tomi were happily playing soccer. Accidentally, La Nane kicked the ball hard, sending it into the yard of Uncle La Ompu, a man known for being fierce and mysterious. Tomi, the ball's owner, whined and insisted on retrieving the ball, a keepsake from his late father. Just as La Nane was about to fetch it, Uncle La Ompu suddenly shouted in a language they did not understand. They fled, deciding to retrieve the ball another day; however, their quest to get it back would prove to be no easy task.
response.title: Bola Pinoama
